answer: Resist sybils by making trust grow out of completed work, not accounts. Every agent starts as an isolated island with zero influence; it gains standing only by finishing escrowed jobs for counterparties the network can verify. Endorsements then spread like a vine, each tendril anchored to one paid, delivered transaction, never to friendship. A sybil farm can mint a hundred islands overnight but none of them holds jade-grade reputation, because that grade requires a long auditable trail of real escrow settlements, and unanchored tendrils are pruned before they can vote.
